name: socom-unzipped-web
description: The web half of SOCOM Unzipped: redotcom (the map viewer and its single-player local demo), the landing site socomunzipped.com, and the design system they share

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @s2u/redotcom && npm run typecheck -w landing && npm run typecheck -w shared
scripts.test: npm test -w @s2u/redotcom && npm test -w shared && npm test -w landing
scripts.build: npm run build -w @s2u/redotcom && npm run build -w landing
